_comment: English edition (India) government resources. A hand-checked list: each URL was opened (HTTP 200) on 2026-11-07. meity.gov.in, pib.gov.in, indiacode.nic.in, mohfw.gov.in and abdm.gov.in returned 403 or no connection to automated requests, so they are not listed and no fact depends on them. cdscomdonline.gov.in did not connect.

meta.title: Official Indian resources for hospital AI decisions
meta.description: Official sources behind this site: CDSCO medical device pages and public notices, the National Single Window System, ICMR guidelines, the Gazette and the Medical Council.
meta.lead: This page collects the official sources behind the rest of this site, each one opened and checked.

notice: This list is not an endorsement and not complete. Pages and rules change; rely on the current text at each source.

programs.name: CDSCO — medical devices and diagnostics
programs.body: CDSCO’s medical device section, with the Medical Devices Rules, classification lists and guidance documents, including the Guidance Document on Medical Device Software.
programs.audience: Procurement, clinical engineering and compliance staff.

programs.name: CDSCO — public notices
programs.body: The list of CDSCO’s public notices, including draft guidance documents posted for stakeholder comments. The Calendar page of this site lists the device-related notices from it.

programs.name: National Single Window System
programs.body: The portal through which CDSCO’s guidance says applications for a test licence for medical device software are submitted.

programs.name: ICMR — guidelines
programs.body: ICMR’s guidelines page, which lists the 2023 ethical guidelines for the application of AI in biomedical research and healthcare and other ethics guidance.
programs.audience: Ethics committees, research and quality staff.

programs.name: e-Gazette of India
programs.body: The Gazette of India, where Central Government rules and notifications are published. The DPDP Act itself was published in it (Extraordinary, 11 August 2023).

programs.name: National Medical Commission — rules and regulations
programs.body: The National Medical Commission’s page on its rules and regulations.
programs.sourceLabel: National Medical Commission — rules and regulations
